backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing booking and review management with storage mixin, including functions to add/approve/delete reviews, add bookings, and query reviews by service, rating, or approval status.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three high-confidence features: replacing service card images with professional photos, fixing search bar functionality with real-time filtering, and fixing mobile dropdown scrolling issues.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components and pages, describing navigation, layout, service displays, booking forms, contact pages, and interactive features with specific implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for backgrounds, borders, cards, and UI components using HSL color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with cache-control meta tags, viewport configuration, and root div for React app mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component using TanStack Router to define routes for Home, Services, Pricing, Booking, Contact, and Reviews pages, wrapped in Layout with scroll-to-top functionality.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: Carousel component displaying up to 6 approved reviews with star ratings, avatars, and glass-morphism cards, using shadcn/ui Carousel with loading skeletons and empty state handling.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Fixed floating WhatsApp button in bottom-right corner with official green color (#25D366), pulse animation, notification badge, and link to wa.me/918884447229.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying company info, contact details (phone, email, address), quick navigation links, social media icons, and a service availability banner. Includes WhatsApp integration and payment method icons.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section component with full-width background image, gradient overlay, and centered call-to-action button linking to the booking page.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that includes Navbar, Footer, FloatingWhatsAppButton, and a watermarked TrustFix logo background pattern.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile menu, search functionality with dropdown results, and scroll-based styling changes. Handles service search and navigation.
frontend/src/components/PricingCard.tsx: Card component displaying individual service pricing information including name, category, description, starting price, and a booking button.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Card component for displaying customer reviews with avatar, name, service, star rating, review text, and date.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Card component for displaying service details with image, category badge, name, description, price, and booking button. Includes hover effects and image error handling.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: Grid layout displaying eight service categories (Pest Control, Carpentry, Cleaning, etc.) as clickable cards with icons and images. Includes intersection observer for scroll animations.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: Interactive or read-only star rating component (1-5 stars) with optional click handlers and visual feedback.
frontend/src/components/SuccessPopup.tsx: Modal popup component displaying success messages with auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, featuring a checkmark icon and close button.
React form component for submitting customer reviews with fields for name, service selection, star rating, review text, and optional photo upload. Uses useReviewSubmission hook to handle form submission and displays a success popup on completion.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Static data export containing service catalog organized by categories (Pest Control, Carpentry, Cleaning, Electrical) with each service having id, name, description, price, and image path properties.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, automatically invalidating and refetching dependent queries when the identity changes.
Custom hook for handling service booking form submissions that saves data to the backend actor and opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled booking message. Manages submission state and success status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options for idle handling and delegation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching approved reviews across all service types and retrieving all bookings from the backend actor, with proper dependency management on actor availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useReviewSubmission.t: Custom hook for submitting customer reviews to the backend, handling photo file conversion to ExternalBlob format, and invalidating the reviews query cache on successful submission.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchServices.ts: Debounced search hook that filters services from servicesData based on query string matching against service name, category, or description with 300ms delay.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom TrustFix brand colors (green/orange theme), CSS variables for light/dark modes, glassmorphism utilities, and custom animations (fade-in, slide-up, wave-in, bounce-slow, pulse-slow).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: Service booking form page with fields for name, phone, email, service selection, address, and message. Pre-fills service from URL params and displays success popup after submission using useBookingSubmission hook.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying company contact information (phone, email, location), WhatsApp chat button, embedded Google Maps, and a contact form with basic alert-based submission.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Homepage with HeroSection, ServiceCategoryGrid, and FeaturedReviewsCarousel components. Implements intersection observer for scroll-triggered animations on sections.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: Pricing page displaying all services organized by category with PricingCard components. Shows an alert noting that final prices depend on inspection and actual work required.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: Customer reviews page with filtering by service category, average rating display, review cards grid, and WriteReviewForm component. Fetches approved reviews using useGetApprovedReviews hook.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: Services catalog page with tabbed navigation by category, displays ServiceCard components in a grid. Supports URL params for category/service selection and auto-scrolls to specific services with highlight animation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color palette using OKLCH color space (including primary, secondary, destructive, sidebar, and TrustFix brand colors), custom shadows (glass effects), border radius variables, and keyframe animations for accordions.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a TrustFix Home Services web application built with React/TypeScript and Motoko backend, featuring 6 pages with glassmorphism design, customer review approval workflow, booking system with WhatsApp integration, search functionality, and detailed architectural notes about routing, state management, and contact information.
